# Reset your password

Reset your password when you forget it or when an admin asks you to.

## Before you begin

You need access to the email address on your account.

## Steps

1. On the sign-in page, click **Forgot password**.
2. Open the reset email and follow the link within 2 hours.
3. Log in with the new password.

## Verify the change

Fernbook opens your home page. If the link expires, request a new one from the login page.

# Connect Fernbook to your identity provider

Connect Fernbook to your identity provider so your team signs in with one account.

## Prerequisites

You need the Owner role, a metadata URL, an entity ID and a certificate.

## Procedure

1. In Settings, open the Single sign-on tab; paste the metadata URL.
2. Click Save.
3. Run fernbook-cli verify-sso to test the connection.

## Verify the connection

The tab shows a green check mark.

# Pin a note

Pin a note to keep it at the top of its notebook.

## Before you begin

You need edit access to the notebook.

## Steps

1. Open the note.
2. Click **More** > **Pin to top**.

## Verify the result

The note moves to the top of the list. To unpin it, click **More** > **Unpin**.

# How sync works

Kestrel Sync keeps every device on the same version of your files, and it resolves conflicts by keeping both copies until you pick the one to keep.

## Core concepts

Each change is recorded by the sync service as an event. NEVER edit the event log by hand.

## Architecture

![Sync architecture](sync.png)

# Workspaces and notebooks

A workspace holds the notebooks, members, and settings of one team, and every notebook belongs to exactly one workspace at a time.

## Core concepts

- **Workspace** – The container for the notebooks and members of a team.
- **Notebook** – A collection of notes with its own sharing settings.

# Sync stops on a metered connection

## Symptom

On macOS 15, the tray icon turns gray, and files stop syncing.

## Cause

Your operating system marks the connection as metered. As mentioned above, Kestrel Sync pauses on metered connections.

## Resolution

You might want to turn off **Pause on metered connections** in **Settings** > **Network**.

# Export fails with error E4012

## Resolution

Clear the export cache in **Settings** > **Storage**, then export again.

## Symptom

The export stops at 90 percent and shows error E4012.

## Cause

Our export service rejects a cache that is older than 30 days.

# Tour of the board view

Learn the board view.

1. Press **New board**.
2. Click the **Name** field.
3. Type `Roadmap` in the **Name** field.
4. Click **Create**.

# How permissions flow

Permissions flow down from a workspace to its notebooks, and a notebook can only narrow the access that its workspace grants.

## Core ideas

- **Inheritance** – A notebook starts with the permissions of its workspace.
- **Narrowing** – A notebook can remove access, but it cannot add access.

## Try it

1. Open a notebook.
2. Click **Share**.
